lines: Sand is vanishing five times faster than in nineteen seventy, and you're standing on it.
We now mine fifty billion tonnes of sand and gravel a year, five times nineteen seventy's pace.
Rivers replace just thirteen billion tonnes a year, so we take sand four times faster.
China pours about fifty one percent of the world's cement, mostly sand and gravel.
Somehow, the beach is the crisis.

reference_text: Every number on this channel comes from a real source. Today we are looking at something you probably walk on every single day, and it turns out the world is using it up faster than nature can make more.
